question: How is the production of PERSIANN-CDR Daily funded, and has that funding been stable, or cut or threatened, between January 1, 2025 and November 2026? (Part 3: funding routes for the producing group, CHRS at UC Irvine, and NCEI only as host; ratings imminent / emerging / no current threat found)

claims.text: NOAA's CDR Program was set up to select PIs competitively to develop CDRs, with routine production possibly at another facility; an AMS 2019 abstract by NCEI says the CDR Program ended as a program in the 2015 NCEI reorganization, while NCEI documents (2025 user guide) still call PERSIANN-CDR part of the CDR Program with quarterly operational updates.
claims.confidence_reason: NCEI's own documents; the 2015 statement rests on one abstract read by WebFetch extraction.

evidence.passage: The CDR Program of the Remote Sensing and Applications Division (RSAD) of NCDC | is responsible for the development of CDRs. The actual | production of CDR data may take place within NCDC or at another suitable facility.

The PERSIANN CDR dataset is publicly available as an operational climate data record through | NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI). … Yes, PERSIANN CDR is part of NOAA’s Climate Data Record (CDR) Program and is | subject to operational updates (forward processing).
